Design Principle Keep vaults stable, understandable, and usable during normal work. Prefer simple human workflows over continuous background restructuring. Structural cleanup, consistency checks, and generated support-file updates are performed periodically through an AI-assisted maintenance pass. Governance Rules Approved Content - `main` is the approved vault state. - Normal contributors do not write directly to `main`. - Human and AI changes enter through pull requests. - Either authorized approver may approve and merge. - Approvers have full authority, including on their own proposals. - Editing a proposal is not approval; approval remains an explicit action. Proposal Ownership - Human contributors use short-lived review branches. - AI contributors use isolated task branches. - A proposal may accumulate edits until its review batch is completed. - The author may edit any file on their own proposal branch. - Other normal users may view and comment, but not edit that branch. - Approvers may edit any proposal. - Do not rewrite contributor history with force pushes. Deferred Work - Unaccepted recommendations may remain open with a `deferred` label. - Deferred proposals remain visible and commentable. - They are retained until explicitly revised, accepted, withdrawn, or closed. -

Architecture System - **Obsidian** — normal human interface. - **GitHub** — authoritative store and approved history. - **Sync agent** — one machine-level process managing all locally authorized vaults. - **GitHub workflow** — proposals, review, validation, approval, and merge. - **AI tools** — contributors using the same proposal workflow as people. Normal users should not need to operate Git. Vault Model Use independent sibling repositories, not nested Git repositories. - **Shared vault** — common company knowledge, standards, instructions, and references. - **Scoped vaults** — role-, project-, function-, or access-limited work. - Shared information stays authoritative in one location and is referenced rather than copied. - Repository access determines whether a user can access a scoped vault. - The sync agent registers only vaults the authenticated user can access.
